title: Giraffe eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='giraffeBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#FFD34E'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#F5B92E'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='68' width='7' height='24' rx='3' fill='#F5B92E'/>
  <rect x='48' y='68' width='7' height='24' rx='3' fill='#F5B92E'/>
  <rect x='62' y='68' width='7' height='24' rx='3' fill='#F5B92E'/>
  <rect x='74' y='68' width='7' height='24' rx='3' fill='#F5B92E'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='88' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8A5A1E'/>
  <rect x='48' y='88' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8A5A1E'/>
  <rect x='62' y='88' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8A5A1E'/>
  <rect x='74' y='88' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#8A5A1E'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='66' rx='27' ry='14' fill='url(#giraffeBody)'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='62' r='5' fill='#B87A22'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='64' r='6' fill='#B87A22'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='60' r='4' fill='#B87A22'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='70' r='4' fill='#B87A22'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M72 62 Q80 40 76 18 L88 18 Q92 44 84 66 Z' fill='#F5B92E'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='52' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#B87A22'/>
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='38' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#B87A22'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='26' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#B87A22'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <path d='M72 18 Q66 10 70 5 Q78 0 92 4 Q100 8 98 16 Q96 22 86 22 Z' fill='#FFD34E'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='90' cy='14' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#FFE9A8'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='94' cy='13' r='1.5' fill='#B87A22'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#5A3A12'/>
  <circle cx='80.8' cy='9.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <rect x='73' y='0' width='4' height='9' rx='2' fill='#C98A2A'/>
  <rect x='82' y='0' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#C98A2A'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='1' r='3' fill='#8A5A1E'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='1' r='3' fill='#8A5A1E'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='8' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#F5B92E' transform='rotate(-25 68 8)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M26 62 Q18 60 16 68' stroke='#F5B92E' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='69' r='3' fill='#8A5A1E'/>
  <!-- snack: leafy branch -->
  <line x1='96' y1='20' x2='88' y2='28' stroke='#6B8E23' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='94' cy='24' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#7BC043' transform='rotate(-30 94 24)'/>
  <ellipse cx='99' cy='20' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#8ED94E' transform='rotate(20 99 20)'/>
  <ellipse cx='90' cy='30' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#7BC043' transform='rotate(-40 90 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='96' cy='31' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#8ED94E' transform='rotate(10 96 31)'/>
  <!-- mouth chewing -->
  <path d='M88 18 Q91 21 95 18' stroke='#B87A22' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
